entries.mechanism:
New York's broad-based categorical eligibility (SNAP 200-percent-class
state option; PolicyEngine models gross screen x1.3 FPL, x2 for
elderly/disabled households, at 2026-01 per gov/hhs/tanf/non_cash
parameters) is not in the composed us-ny/snap/fy-2026 program, which
applies only the standard federal tests. Every selected row is verified
per-row against axiom's persisted output surface: household gross income
sits inside the band above the federal 130 percent limit the composed
program applies and at or below the state's BBCE screen, verified
against axiom's own computed gross income and limit. Axiom-side modeling
boundary, tracked for encoding in rulespec-us#1098. The requested-month
regeneration preserves all five case identities and their boolean
left/right values exactly, so the evidence remains current.
